title: ServiceTangibility
description: ISO 25011 quality archetype — Tangibility viability dimension. Degree to which the tangible aspects of an IT service (reports, portals, dashboards, communication materials) meet user expectations. Sub-characteristics: Visibility, Professionalism, IT Service Interface Appearance. Rootless archetype — unique to service quality, no product-quality equivalent. Source: ISO/IEC TS 25011:2017 §7.5.

visibility.description: Degree to which the IT service status, metrics, and operational state are observable by users. OPAQUE = no visibility. PARTIAL = limited dashboards/reports. TRANSPARENT = full real-time observability.

professionalism.description: Degree to which the IT service presentation and communications demonstrate credibility and competence.

interfaceAppearance.description: Degree to which the IT service interface appearance is adequate and meets user expectations for visual quality.
